snippet.title: BEATABLE Launch Trailer – Feel the Rhythm in Your Hands (Out Today on Meta Quest)
snippet.description:
Step into the future of rhythm gaming with BEATABLE. No controllers, no buttons—just your hands and your table, transformed into a musical canvas. Tap, clap, and snap to an electrifying soundtrack featuring platinum-selling artists and rising stars. This isn’t just a game. It’s rhythm, reimagined.

What sets BEATABLE apart? Your table becomes the beat. Your hands bring it to life. Fully hand-tracked, controller-free immersion. Mixed reality that fuses the real and the virtual. A killer lineup with Tom Zanetti, RDB, Jamie Vice, and more. Designed for flow, crafted to captivate.

The buzz is building:
“That ‘aha!’ moment when creativity gifts you something special! ” – Money Mark,  ⁨@BeastieBoys 
“An instant classic!” –  ⁨@tomzanettitz 
“The next era of rhythm gaming!” – @Naysy 
“Simple to learn, hard to master and addictive fun!” – @GAMERTAGVR 
"Finally, hand tracking done right."  ⁨@Gamingwithmatteo311⁩  
“Rhythm revolution—addictive and immersive!” – @MissChiefVR 

Join the BEATABLE community:
Discord → https://discord.gg/S5jCDhNW
Spotify Playlist → https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1A1YpurewsW3UWPLfySocX
Press Kit → https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1305hRVf74XJkrjVs8DC3aQttIW-FN_dD?usp=sharing  

Media/Review Inquiries: bobby.thandi@xrgames.io  

No controllers. No distractions. Just rhythm, redefined.

#BEATABLE  #VR #MetaQuest3 #MetaQuest3s #MetaQuest2 #RhythmGaming #Rhythm #MixedReality #HandTracking #XRGames
